notes.title: Important Update Information April 7, 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37032048/206ed0c87964a6661e74993e82ae4a66a57d7928.jpg[/img]

Dear players:

It has been nearly two weeks since the game was officially released.
We received a lot of feedback from players, including suggestions, opinions, affirmations, and criticisms.

We thank you for your interest in this game.
We are about to launch a free game music DLC and expect to update the fourth female character in April.

The content of this update is based on player feedback
1. The function of "ESC" is changed to "Quit Game"
2. The function of "Space" is changed to hide UI in album mode
3. Added cheating code "1919". When you are playing a picture, enter "1919", you can directly complete the picture.
4. Added a new achievement "Emperor's New Clothes"
5. Ways to cancel censorship: On the game start interface, enter 810 directly and press Enter.

I hope that the players who bought the game can leave us a review. If you have any comments or suggestions, please leave us a message.

Have fun

Thank you

CAT TEAM
April 7, 2020"
